gen-tourney-gf-sintony: Stretched, sporty, unmistakably loud. Sintony follows with a chunky, tall midzone and smooth curves that never clog, giving Tourney's wide-tracked heading a body that feels grounded.
gen-tourney-gf-sofia-sans: Athletic from the first glance, Tourney cuts every stroke to one width and spaces its words wide. Sofia Sans takes over below with rounded, tall lowercase and open sides, and a modest body size lets those stencil-like shapes breathe.
gen-tourney-gf-sofia-sans-semi-condensed: Sofia Sans Semi Condensed sits beneath Tourney's stretched, bulky heading with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed would carry a long page with a constant stencil-like line and wide entrances into each curve, so the reading stays smooth.
gen-tourney-gf-sono: Sono brings tall lowercase, generous default spacing and a slightly ajar a to the body. Tourney's wide-tracked, single-width strokes stay bold above it, and the sans below keeps the page approachable.
gen-tourney-gf-stack-sans-notch: Bold, stretched Tourney heads the pair, while Stack Sans Notch follows below with open curves and rod-stock strokes that feel big-bodied in every word. A longer passage would read steadily, with nothing clogged.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-stack-sans-text: Big-eyed and confident, Unica One draws every curve with visible daylight inside. Stack Sans Text meets it with marker-like lines and well-spaced curve endings, so the plain sans feels sturdy beside the heading.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-sulphur-point: Commanding Wallpoet rises high with smooth bends and paper showing between its letters. Yet Sulphur Point's marker-like, zero-contrast line and open gaps keep a longer passage of this sans-serif easy to follow.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-tiktok-sans: Expressive, brushy, wide open. Warnes tapers its single-width strokes like a sign-painter, while TikTok Sans reads smoothly in longer stretches, its tall x-height and spacious c keeping lines clear.
gen-irish-grover-gf-ubuntu-sans: Fun and a bit wobbly, Irish Grover has sturdy tall lowercase and the soft thick-thin shift of a lightly pressed brush. Ubuntu Sans does the opposite job, offering a steady, unshaded outline with big round eyes in its plain sans letters.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-vend-sans: Vend Sans draws a ruler-straight line with wide, unclosed curve endings and an x-height that fills the line. And Luckiest Guy, loud and poured at one width, gives that plain sans body a cheerful shout above.
